<includeonly>{{#if:{{{stablekey|}}}|<infobox type="Quest">
	<title><default>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|field|name}}</default></title>
	<image><default>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|field|image}}</default><caption><default>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|field|imagecaption}}</default></caption></image>
	<data><label>Location:</label><default>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|field|location}}</default></data>
	<data><label>Repeatable:</label><default>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|field|repeatable}}</default></data>
    <header>Requirements</header>
	<data><label>Prerequisite:</label><default>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|field|prerequisite}}</default></data>
	<data><label>Level:</label><default>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|field|level}}</default></data>
	<data><label>Item(s) Required:</label><default>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|field|itemsrequired}}</default></data>
	<header>Rewards</header>
	<data><label>Experience:</label><default>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|field|experience}}</default></data>
	<data><label>Gold:</label><default>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|field|gold}}</default></data>
	<data><label>Faction Changes:</label><default>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|field|factionchanges}}</default></data>
	<data><label>Item(s):</label><default>{{#if:{{{items|}}}|{{#ifeq:{{{items|}}}|-||{{{items|}}}}}|{{QuestRewardsQuery|stablekey={{{stablekey|}}}}}}}</default></data>
	<group layout="horizontal">
		<header>Quest Progression</header>
		<data><label>Previous:</label><default>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|field|previous}}</default></data>
		<data><label>Next:</label><default>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|field|next}}</default></data>
	</group>
</infobox>{{#invoke:Erenshor/Quest|status}}{{#ifeq:{{NAMESPACENUMBER}}|0|[[Category:Quests]]}}|<infobox type="Quest">
	<title source="title"/>
	<image source="image"><caption source="imagecaption"/></image>
	    <data source="location"><label>Location:</label></data>
		<data source="repeatable"><label>Repeatable:</label></data>
    <header>Requirements</header>
		<data source="prerequisite"><label>Prerequisite:</label></data>
		<data source="level"><label>Level:</label></data>
		<data source="items required"><label>Item(s) Required:</label></data>
	<header>Rewards</header>
		<data source="experience"><label>Experience:</label></data>
		<data source="gold"><label>Gold:</label></data>
		<data source="factionchanges"><label>Faction Changes:</label></data>
		<data source="items"><label>Item(s):</label></data>
	<group layout="horizontal">
		<header>Quest Progression</header>
		<data source="previous"><label>Previous:</label></data>
		<data source="next"><label>Next:</label></data>
	</group>
</infobox>{{#ifeq: {{NAMESPACENUMBER}} | 0 | [[Category:Quests]]}}}}</includeonly><noinclude>{{Documentation}}
Template parameters mirror the production Quest template. Article parameters override generated Lua data; use <code>-</code> to intentionally blank a supported generated field.
</noinclude>
